summary: Windows + PowerShell production-readiness tracker focused on test coverage, verification commands, quality gates, security checks, build checks, release checks, and manual verification requirements for a new production project with no legacy/workaround tolerance.
active_objective: Make verification evidence sufficient before treating the repository as production-ready.

Canonical readiness command is pwsh .\scripts\Invoke-Gate.ps1 -Configuration Release.
Installer/package readiness additionally requires installer-inclusive gate and signed installer lifecycle evidence on a clean Windows profile.
No source, test, script, documentation, dependency, or configuration files may be changed during this review.
